purpose: Convert approved academic claims into teachable conversational narration
inputs: Approved LessonPlan, claim IDs, prerequisites, independent answer key
steps: State the capability; identify one prerequisite repair; write a concrete opening; explain why each worked step is chosen; fade support; end with an independent task.
negative_test: Reject fabricated teacher biography, unsupported facts and promises of marks.
status_cost: Original authored conversation pass; no provider calls.

purpose: Remove robotic phrasing without changing scientific meaning
steps: Read aloud syntactically; shorten excessive clauses; replace generic transitions with reasoning; preserve units, qualifiers and formal exam terms; check last20 scripts for repeated boilerplate.
negative_test: A smoother draft cannot delete not, increase/decrease, conditions or negative exponents.
status_cost: Bounded edit pass; do not rewrite approved paragraphs unnecessarily.

purpose: Use a small helpful story or analogy with explicit limits
steps: Choose a familiar relationship; map only relevant parts; identify failure conditions; attach one predictive question; return to the formal representation.
negative_test: Reject human intentions as causes in molecules, enzymes or evolution.
status_cost: No generation API; zero analogies is valid.

purpose: Add optional concept-linked humour without ridicule
outputs: Up to a few removable lines; no mandatory quota
steps: Locate a harmless misconception contrast; draft a short observation; check science and dignity; mark timing; remove anything funnier than it is useful.
negative_test: Reject mocking marks, intelligence, caste, gender, accent, economic status or copyrighted reaction clips without rights.
status_cost: Small editing pass; do not rerun entire script.

purpose: Build competence through real attempts and specific feedback
inputs: Objectives, questions, misconceptions and answer keys
outputs: Support progression; feedback; calibrated progress text
steps: Identify meaningful small wins; separate followed-with-support from independent performance; add a repair path; avoid urgency and exaggerated claims.
negative_test: Reject unconditional You got it right in a prerecorded lesson.
status_cost: One review of checkpoints, not generic motivational prose.

purpose: Create task-specific prompts, hidden answers and response windows
inputs: Question bank, segment structure, required drawings/calculations
outputs: Question and answer segments with dependency IDs and Pause nodes
steps: Choose predict/explain/write/draw/solve; define task; keep answer out of all media; assign exact static hold and optional user pause; attach targeted feedback and next attempt.
negative_test: Reject answers before response window, fake listening and copying while new science is narrated.
status_cost: Local timing; no paid audio generated for silence.

purpose: Apply a stable identity and purpose-linked delivery
outputs: Direction records, emphasis, pronunciation audition list
steps: Use steady base; curious question; deliberate formula; dry humour; supportive correction; vary at semantic boundaries; avoid sentence-by-sentence overacting.
negative_test: Reject deliberate errors, artificial ums, identity imitation, shouting and forced laughter.
status_cost: Reuse approved voice profile; no blind synthesis of all candidates.

purpose: Control cognitive pace without rigid scene slots
inputs: Segment text, concepts, actual audio durations and tasks
outputs: Duration report; boundary changes; external hold schedule
steps: Estimate first; generate actual voice; measure active rate and pauses; shorten redundant language before accelerating; lengthen animation; split a chapter if necessary.
negative_test: Reject automatic speeding of equations to force ten minutes.
status_cost: Prefer re-timing visuals to paid resynthesis.

purpose: Create explicit context-aware readings of notation
outputs: Versioned spoken/display/caption mappings and test corpus
steps: Identify ambiguous symbols; require intended mathematical meaning; spell units/negation/direction; write explicit aliases; test one segment; review acoustic realization.
negative_test: Reject inverse sine interpreted as reciprocal sine, mA/MA confusion, molarity/molality merging and unreviewed IPA.
status_cost: Cache dictionaries by used entries; expand before synthesis.

purpose: Produce audience-appropriate language without semantic drift
inputs: Approved script, examination medium, locale term ledger
steps: Use one main language; keep required scientific terms; code-switch purposefully; verify values and signs; use native-script text and native reviewer; do not substitute Bengali for Assamese.
negative_test: Reject marketing language counts as proof of accent quality or code-switch fluency.
status_cost: Translate text and reflow audio/visuals separately; not unconditional dubbing.

outputs: Offline requests; usage estimate; later provider-job record
steps: Check model/locale/endpoint; resolve aliases; map supported controls only; keep directions separate; reserve cost; send once only in production worker; persist response/job ID.
negative_test: Reject unsupported SSML, plaintext secrets, unverified voices and unknown-status resubmission.
status_cost: compiler.py implemented offline; live transport pending.

purpose: Use measured audio timing for educational visuals
inputs: Final segment WAVs, validated alignments, cue occurrences
outputs: Sample-index timeline, cue frames, captions, protected holds
steps: Check audio/text hashes; verify timestamps and coverage; locate explicit phrase occurrence; concatenate final PCM; insert exact silence; map global samples to frames once; test answer reveal.
negative_test: Reject guessed uniform word timing for production; synthetic fixture cannot pass release.
status_cost: timeline.py implemented; actual aligner provider integration pending.

purpose: Produce clear dialogue masters without erasing useful dynamics
inputs: Accepted raw audio plus mixing and protected-silence manifest
outputs: Archival WAV, deliverable audio, pre/post measurements
steps: Decode once; verify channels/rate; preserve source; use two-pass loudnorm; remeasure; inspect speech boundaries; encode then recheck final container; clean only genuine noise.
negative_test: Reject unnecessary denoise/reverb/music and silenceremove applied across thinking windows.
status_cost: Local FFmpeg mastering tested on signals, not speech audition.

purpose: Detect text, signal, timing and performance defects
inputs: Canonical transcript, independent ASR, alignments, audio, visuals
outputs: Severity-ranked issues and hash-bound review evidence
steps: Compare ASR without answer-text bias; examine critical words; measure technical audio; listen to hard terms and whole lesson; inspect cue moments; escalate ambiguity to teacher/native reviewer.
negative_test: Reject WER0 or neural MOS as proof of scientific pronunciation and teaching success.
status_cost: Local surface comparator and measurements implemented; human review mandatory.

purpose: Minimize duplicate generation and track actual costs
inputs: Provider requests, quotes, job states, caches, accepted variants
outputs: Usage ledger; scoped invalidation; retry decision
steps: Hash speech-relevant inputs; reuse approved samples; ignore visual-only edits; store provider job ID; reconcile unknown status; cap tries; reserve budget; record accepted cost including failures.
negative_test: Reject repeated submission after timeout and unlimited attempts to chase a vibe.
status_cost: Local hashing/cache checks implemented; distributed paid-job ledger remains production work.
